paper_title: Novel Constraints on Axions Produced in Pulsar Polar-Cap Cascades
notes: Paper derives constraints on axion-photon coupling g_agamma using radio observations of 27 nearby pulsars. The mechanism is axion production in neutron star polar-cap vacuum gaps, with resonant conversion to photons in the magnetosphere. The limits are the strongest to date for masses 10^-8 eV ≲ m_a ≲ 10^-5 eV. Data points extracted from Fig. 2 (upper panel showing the fiducial 95% CL limit band). The constraint does NOT assume axions are dark matter, unlike haloscope and radio line searches. Modeling uncertainties (factor ~2) are captured in the band shown in Fig. 2. The coupling values are read from the figure with typical uncertainty of ±0.2 dex. The paper uses both 2.5D PIC simulations and a semi-analytic model; the final limits take the weaker constraint at each mass from both approaches. | selector: text (sole candidate)
